socialAccounts.title: Social account protection
socialAccounts.description: Register the social accounts to protect. Each day the platform is searched for accounts with similar names, scored by name, avatar, bio and account age. Name-only matches are low severity and do not alert; medium and above open an alert, and evidence comes from uploaded screenshots. Platform failures are retried in about an hour.
socialAccounts.removeConfirm: Delete this protected account and its candidates? Existing alerts are kept.
socialAccounts.handleHint: Bluesky: the handle (e.g. example.bsky.social). Mastodon: user@instance. Cannot be changed after saving.
socialAccounts.label: Label
socialAccounts.extraQueriesHint: One per line, up to 5, e.g. names in other languages. The display name and handle are searched automatically.
socialAccounts.allowedAccountsHint: One handle or permanent platform ID per line; these are never treated as impersonation (fan pages, regional offices).
socialAccounts.adapterOffHint: The Bluesky and Mastodon adapters are off by default and run only after legal approval and enabling.
socialAccounts.leadHint: Similarity is only a lead for review: a similar avatar or name does not prove impersonation. Once confirmed, upload screenshots in the alert and report to the platform.
socialAccounts.mastodonScope: Mastodon has no network-wide search; only accounts known to the configured instances are covered. Add searched instances to the takedown platform list so manual submissions of their links are not visited by the sandbox.
socialAccounts.allowConfirm: Add this account to the known legitimate accounts? It will no longer be treated as impersonation.

keywords.intro: These domain keywords share the domain section in Settings → Keyword rules. Each save creates a version. Enabled, runnable CT streams, crt.sh and dnstwist discover candidates using their supported fields and schedules; adding a term does not complete an immediate Internet-wide scan.
keywords.textScopeHint: Domain keywords and text keywords are configured separately and do not sync automatically. To match a brand in page text, also add it to the text keyword sets (sets.terms).
keywords.tokenHint: Unicode letters (including Chinese), digits and hyphens, 2–63 characters. Letters are saved in lowercase.

keywords.lookalikeHint: Domains of legitimate third parties no longer raise alerts; existing alerts must be handled on the alert page.
keywords.removeBody: Domains and alerts already found are kept; new domains will no longer be matched on this keyword.

llm.codeEnabledHelp: When a public repository scan finds credentials, the model judges whether each looks like real configuration or a sample, and how the repository relates to the organization. It only reorders alerts and never suppresses one. Sent: masked lines around each hit (3 before and after), file paths, rule names and public repository details. Never sent: credential values, email addresses or private keywords. The model cannot tell whether a credential still works.

llm.overseasAlert: Content will be sent to a third party outside the country. Only filtered public content is sent (title, summary, matched excerpts, source and the organization's public name).

access.modelHint: Custom roles combine permission sets. Users can receive sets directly. Effective permissions combine all grants. Built-in definitions are fixed. API changes take effect immediately; the UI refreshes within 15 seconds.

access.usernameHint: 2–64 lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens
access.passwordResetDone: Password reset. Sessions ended; the user must change their password on next sign-in.
access.sessionsEffect: This takes effect immediately. Ended sessions require a new sign-in.
access.resetHint: Local accounts only. Resetting ends all sessions and requires a password change on next sign-in. SSO passwords are managed by the identity provider.

access.forcePasswordHint: Change your initial or reset password before using the platform.
access.idpRoles: Identity provider roles: {{roles}}. Roles and sets assigned here supplement these and survive SSO synchronization.
access.assignmentHint: Effective permissions combine roles and directly assigned sets. Accounts without grants cannot access business features.
access.name: Name
access.superadminHint: Superadmins receive all current and future permissions. Only superadmins can manage or grant this role.
access.builtinHint: Built-in grants are fixed. Create a custom role or permission set to tailor access.
